image_slots.scene_description: দাগ দিই ও রং করি (পৃষ্ঠা ১) — বেলুন, জ্যামিতিক আকৃতি (বৃত্ত, ত্রিভুজ, কর্ণসহ বর্গ), ফুল-পাপড়ি, পাতা, টিউলিপ, ঘাস; কিছু ডট-আউটলাইন ট্রেসিং, কিছু সলিড রং করার জন্য। কোনো জীবন্ত প্রাণী নেই, কোনো আকৃতিতে মুখ নেই, লেখা নেই।
image_slots.compliance_note: object-only trace/colour page; shapes + plants only, no living being, no face on any shape, no flag, no in-image text (script guard). Generated fresh (regenerate-all-art preference). No stripe.
image_slots.prompt: A black-and-white line-art trace-and-colour activity page for a young child (age 5-6). Clean bold outlines only, no shading, no fill, no colour, on a white background; high contrast, thick clear lines legible when photocopied. A mix of simple shapes and objects to trace and colour: a large balloon on a string drawn in a light dashed dotted outline; a few basic geometric shapes (circles, triangles, a square with diagonal lines) some in solid outline and some in dashed trace outline; and a simple flower made of teardrop petals with small leaf and bud shapes, part solid outline and part dashed trace outline, with a little grass and a couple of small tulips along the bottom. Arrange them tidily across one portrait page with generous spacing so a small child can trace the dotted ones and colour inside all of them. Simple, friendly children's-textbook style. No text, no letters, no numbers, no faces on any shape, no people or animals anywhere on the page.

image_slots.scene_description: দাগ দিই ও রং করি (পৃষ্ঠা ২) — ডট-আউটলাইনে একটি বড় সূর্য (বৃত্ত + ত্রিভুজাকার রশ্মি) ট্রেস ও রং করার জন্য; মুখ নেই। কোনো জীবন্ত প্রাণী নেই, লেখা নেই।
image_slots.compliance_note: object-only trace/colour page; plain geometric sun with NO face (C-05-adjacent caution held), no living being, no flag, no in-image text. Generated fresh. No stripe.
image_slots.prompt: A black-and-white line-art trace-and-colour activity page for a young child (age 5-6). Clean bold outlines only, no shading, no fill, no colour, white background; high contrast, thick clear lines legible when photocopied. A single large friendly sun drawn in a light dashed dotted outline for the child to trace over then colour: a round central circle with a ring of pointed triangular rays around it, all as a trace-the-dots outline. Centre the sun on one portrait page with room to trace and colour. Plain geometric sun with no face — no eyes, no mouth. No text, no letters, no numbers, no people or animals anywhere on the page.
